purpose: Defines the state models and permitted transitions for the published ToC, ToC build/rebuild runs, and DLID embedding runs, as normative transition tables that scripts enforce.
summary: Separation of published ToC state from build run progress; rebuild-needed and missing-reference are judgments, not states
Normative rule: transitions not in the tables are rejected and no new confirmed ToC is created
Confirmed ToC transitions P-01 to P-03 (unbuilt, published, failure keeps prior state)
ToC build run transitions B-01 to B-09 from start through scope, IDs, changes, info, reference check, candidate, finish or failure
Build does not rewrite index target documents; AI generation requests only after changes are confirmed
Completion result returned as counts plus a detail file path; failure reports document, field, reason
Reference check result categories and freshness of saved results
DLID embedding run transitions E-01 to E-07 including original confirmation wait and failure without rollback
Test scope for state transitions versus content rules
tasks: Designing or reviewing ToC build and rebuild state handling

Handling build failure and re-run behavior
